name: [CUSTOMIZATION!🎨] DRIFT RNG
desc:
👋 Welcome to DRIFT RNG!

What is DRIFT RNG?
Roll the dice to unlock over 30+ unique cars! 🔄 
Drift around the map to earn money! 🏎️💨
Use your earnings to purchase more rolls and unlock even more cars! 💰
❗(IMPORTANT: CLAIM ATLEAST ONE CAR SO YOU CAN EARN MONEY!)❗

🎮 Vehicle Controls (PC):
WASD:  Drive 🏎️
Left Shift:  Handbrake ⚡
Spacebar:  Exit Vehicle 🚶
SHIFT + P: Free Cam 📸
New Cars Added Weekly!

📢 Join our community for updates and announcements!
